about: A command-line tool for working with an Obsidian notes vault from the terminal.

prs.title: Moving a note updates links to names with spaces
prs.broken: Moving a note whose name had a space left links to it pointing at the old file, because Obsidian writes those spaces as %20.
prs.changed: The move now also rewrites the %20 form of those links.
prs.matters: Moving notes no longer leaves dead links behind.

prs.title: Daily notes fill in the date, time and title
prs.broken: Daily notes made from a template kept the placeholders for date, time and title as raw text in every new note.
prs.changed: The template is now filled in the same way Obsidian's daily notes plugin does it.
prs.matters: Daily notes come out ready to use, as they do in Obsidian.

prs.title: Moving a note onto an existing one no longer deletes it
prs.broken: Moving a note onto a name that was already used silently replaced that note, and its text was gone.
prs.changed: The move now stops with an error when the target note exists. Renaming a note only by letter case still works.
prs.matters: A typo in a move command can no longer wipe out a note.
